## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes locally (lint, clippy, mypy, pytest, spec suite).
- [ ] If the wire format interpretation changed, `spec/xrk_format.py` was updated first and the Cython and Rust backends conform to it.
- [ ] **Maintainers can push to this branch.** Tick "Allow edits by maintainers" in the PR sidebar so we can rebase or fix up the PR in place instead of opening a replacement. GitHub only honours that box for forks under a personal account; if your fork belongs to an organization, either open the PR from a personal fork or grant `m3rlin45` write access to the fork.
